# Treasure AI - llms.txt
## About
Treasure AI is the Agentic Experience Platform built for brands who believe that AI, harnessed by human warmth and creativity, transforms how companies acquire, retain, and grow their most valuable customers 24/7. Treasure AI helps you transition from manually managing your existing SaaS software stack, towards running autonomous ROI-driving AI agents — all powered by layers of integrated customer knowledge.
Website: https://www.treasure.ai

FAQs
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
What exactly is an Agentic Experience Platform, and how is it different from a CDP?
 
 
 
 
 
A traditional CDP collects and segments your customer data — an agentic experience platform acts on it using governed AI. Instead of waiting for marketers to build campaigns, it works with the human in the loop to deploy AI agents that autonomously sense customer intent, make decisions, and orchestrate personalized experiences in real time, across every channel.
This AI experience platform gives you the capabilities of foundational marketing technology all in one, including:
AI customer data platform:
 An always up-to-date understanding of each customer that AI can act on for audience segmentation and activation.
AI customer engagement platform: 
Activate AI-driven personalized engagement across channels for customer acquisition, retention, and growth 24/7.
Enterprise AI orchestration platform: 
Coordinate marketing strategy, planning, execution, and optimization through a unified AI-driven workflow for always-on execution.
AI marketing automation platform: 
Move beyond manual SaaS management to autonomous, ROI-driven AI agents for smarter, measurable growth.
AI advertising platform: 
Execute across major ad platforms continuously, compressing signal-to-action from days to minutes.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Do I need a data science team to get value out of it?
 
 
 
 
 
No. Unlike traditional platforms that require data science support, Treasure AI is built for business users.
Launch abandoned cart recovery, optimize paid media spend, personalize product recommendations, or re-engage high-value customers, while AI agents handle the analysis, decisions, and execution for you.
How do agents know what action to take for each customer?
Agents continuously analyze behavioral signals, purchase history, and real-time context against your defined business objectives. They reason over this data, select the best next action, execute it, and learn from the outcome — tightening their decisions with every interaction.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
How do agents know what action to take for each customer?
 
 
 
 
 
Agents continuously analyze behavioral signals, purchase history, and real-time context against your defined business objectives. They reason over this data, select the best next action, execute it, and learn from the outcome — tightening their decisions with every interaction.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
What guardrails exist to make sure agents don't do something unexpected?
 
 
 
 
 
Every AI agent operates within centrally defined policies, covering budgets, channels, frequency, and compliance requirements. All actions are fully logged, explainable, and auditable, with real-time controls to approve, override, or roll back decisions. This ensures safe, compliant, and scalable execution across your organization.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
The gap isn’t AI vs no AI. It’s speed vs irrelevance.
Don’t fall behind. Start capturing revenue in minutes.

Treasure AI Pricing
Pay for value. Not compute.
Treasure AI prices by customer profiles or behavioral events — not by query volume or processing power. Three tiers: Intelligent CDP for data unification, Intelligent CDP + AI Suites for full omnichannel activation, and Treasure AI Studio for conversational AI. Costs stay predictable as your data scales.

FAQs
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Can I try Treasure AI for free?
 
 
 
 
 
Yes, with a Treasure AI proof of concept (POC), you can try before you buy. Our POCs last two weeks and support use cases ranging from foundational data, to marketing efficiency and activations.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Are AI capabilities included in the Intelligent CDP?
 
 
 
 
 
Yes, Treasure AI's Intelligent CDP includes AI features like Audience Agent. However, the AI Marketing Cloud and Treasure AI Studio are what truly make Treasure AI agentic.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
How can I prove the value of Treasure AI?
 
 
 
 
 
Use our CDP Value Calculator to discover the potential annual value Treasure AI can provide, based on your organizational priorities.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Where is my data stored?
 
 
 
 
 
Treasure AI is a managed cloud-based SaaS data platform. We use AWS data centers, giving you the option to select which region will host your data.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
How long does implementation take?
 
 
 
 
 
The Treasure AI platform is built to deliver value quickly. Traditionally, a typical implementation can take between 8 to 12 weeks. However, our experienced team can leverage AI features to reduce that timeframe to just days.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Why should I trust Treasure AI with my users and my data?
 
 
 
 
 
Security is at the forefront of everything we do. We provide proven protection to deliver exceptional customer experiences using trusted data. We hold industry leading certifications such as ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2 Type 2, and FISC.
Visit our Trust & Security Center to 
find out more
.
